control_name: Container Image Signing and Provenance Verification (Cosign/Sigstore)
description: Require cryptographic signatures on container images before deployment. Cosign/Sigstore verify image provenance against a trust policy, ensuring only images from authorized build pipelines are admitted. Blocks supply chain attacks where a compromised registry or build system pushes malicious images. Verification can be enforced at admission time via policy controllers (Kyverno, Gatekeeper with cosign) or at pull time via container runtime trust policies (Podman policy.json, CRI-O).

cvss_vector_impacts.rationale: Attacker must forge a valid cryptographic signature or compromise the signing key to inject a malicious container image; simply pushing to a registry is insufficient
Unsigned or tampered images are rejected at admission; modifications to images after signing are detected and blocked

verification.method: Verify image signature verification is enforced at admission or runtime level

commands.command: kubectl get clusterimagepolicy --no-headers 2>/dev/null | wc -l || kubectl get policy.sigstore.dev --no-headers 2>/dev/null | wc -l
cosign verify --key <cosign_public_key> <image> 2>&1 | grep -c 'The following checks were performed'

remediation.name: Kyverno ClusterPolicy with cosign image signature verification

steps.description: Create a Kyverno ClusterPolicy that requires cosign signature verification for all images pulled from the target registry. Images without a valid signature matching the specified public key are rejected at admission.
steps.command:
cat <<'POLICY' | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1
kind: ClusterPolicy
metadata:
  name: require-image-signature
spec:
  validationFailureAction: Enforce
  background: false
  rules:
    - name: verify-image-signature
      match:
        any:
          - resources:
              kinds:
                - Pod
      verifyImages:
        - imageReferences:
            - "<registry>/*"
          attestors:
            - entries:
                - keys:
                    publicKeys: |-
                      <cosign_public_key>
POLICY

remediation.name: Podman/CRI-O container image trust policy via policy.json

steps.description: Back up existing container image trust policy and write a new policy.json that requires GPG-signed images from the target registry while allowing default insecure pulls only for explicitly trusted registries
Install the GPG public key used to sign container images into the system keyring directory

remediation.verify: podman image trust show 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'signedBy' && cat /etc/containers/policy.json 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'signedBy'

references.source: Podman — Signing and Verifying Container Images
